text: Analytical Senior Data Analyst with 5+ years of experience transforming complex datasets into actionable business strategies. Expert in SQL, Python, Tableau, and PowerBI. Successfully led data analytics initiatives that boosted revenue by 18% and optimized marketing spend.

Detail-oriented Junior Data Analyst with strong expertise in SQL querying, Excel pivot tables, and PowerBI reporting. Eager to assist cross-functional teams in driving data-backed decision making.
